PySCF 2.14.0 is installed in the user site-packages (`./.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages`), which isn't on the default import path. Let me add it and import.

```python
import sys, os
for p in [os.path.expanduser('~/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages'),
          os.path.join(os.getcwd(), '.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages')]:
    if os.path.isdir(p) and p not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, p)
        print("added:", p)

import importlib
importlib.invalidate_caches()
import pyscf
print("pyscf version:", pyscf.__version__)
```
